warning_indicators: formal legal or alliance thresholds; unusual operational mobilisation
evidence_rule: do not conflate consultation and defence thresholds

warning_indicators: closure of institutions; expulsions; breakdown of senior contacts
counter_indicators: direct talks; ambassador channels; crisis communication; backchannels
evidence_rule: absence of public contact does not prove absence of informal channels

warning_indicators: ultimata; retaliation language; escalatory signalling combined with operational steps
evidence_rule: rhetoric alone has limited standalone weight

warning_indicators: major cyber or sabotage event; broad communication restrictions
evidence_rule: official attribution is not the same as independent proof

warning_indicators: emergency measures without clear oversight or limits
counter_indicators: clear legal basis; time limits; judicial and parliamentary review
evidence_rule: extraordinary measures are not automatically democratic erosion

warning_indicators: critical single-source dependencies; opaque major procurement; concentrated beneficiaries
evidence_rule: benefit or contact does not prove causation

warning_indicators: loss of independent options; critical dependencies; documented external pressure with decision effect
counter_indicators: own capabilities; own diplomatic initiatives; documented policy disagreement; diversified dependencies
evidence_rule: alliance coordination does not prove external control

warning_indicators: single-source claims; circular sourcing; conflation of contact interest motive and cause
counter_indicators: primary documents; independent corroboration; counter-hypotheses; explicit uncertainty
evidence_rule: A-F classes describe evidence type rather than a numerical truth score
